decisions.story_title: miniOrange WordPress SAML SSO plugin auth bypass enables admin takeover
decisions.reason: Two CVEs (CVE-2026-15981, CVE-2026-61979) in a widely-used WordPress SAML plugin with active exploitation targeting admin accounts. Distinct from the Burst Statistics auth bypass story.
Significant policy action: Treasury sanctions four Iranian nationals for hacking critical infrastructure and cybertheft. Belongs in the existing Iranian hacker sanctions story.
Bipartisan Senate legislation requiring federal regulators to prepare the electric grid for quantum computing threats. Policy story with cybersecurity implications, matches existing candidate story.
